gap_reasons.positive/explicit/introduced/input_forma: no real commit found where a library format/framing change makes the unchanged harness fail loudly; best lead (libxml2 834b8123, R2: xmlParserInputBufferCreateMem no longer pre-fills, old fuzz.c entity loader) only overflows for external entities > 8 KiB and was not reproducible on the fixed corpus
gap_reasons.positive/explicit/introduced/lifecycle: no real commit found: every lifecycle-type harness fix located (oss-fuzz + in-tree history of all 38 projects) was either harness-caused or pre-existing; libexpat cfce28e1 (allocation tracker vs assert(XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate)) does not trigger below the 64 MiB activation threshold
gap_reasons.positive/explicit/preexisting/state: no admissible candidate: libsndfile 37609184/1998691e (virtual-IO vfseek lets the offset leave [0,len]) is a callback-contract (api) defect; flac 07471c89 / 9593b949 (static align_reservoir_samples never reset between inputs, FLAC__ASSERT abort on a later input) only reproduces with a hand-built sequence of multi-file command lines and was not pursued
gap_reasons.positive/silent/introduced/mix: candidate brotli 35e69fc7cf (large-window streams + BrotliDecoderSetParameter never called; counterfactual Δh) showed the expected gap (0 in 3/3 seeds without the fix, hit in 2/2 with it) but failed the per-seed execution threshold: the decode harness decodes up to 64 MiB per input and reached only ~44k execs in 600 s even when run alone (threshold 166,666), so under plan §5 the campaign is invalid and the sample was not admitted
gap_reasons.positive/silent/preexisting/mix: candidate cmark 74e8f638 / H 8667a22 rejected: the state component (CR/LF carry-over between cmark_parser_feed chunks) was not reached in budgeted fuzzing and is not separable from the cmark_parse_file component (which also feeds 4096-byte chunks)

conventions_override.type_assignment: labels follow the type definitions of dataset-distribution.md: api = public symbol signature/semantics/new mandatory call of an API the harness calls; configuration = compile-time macros, runtime flags/options, build switches; input_format = accepted input format/syntax/encoding/magic; state = internal state, globals, reset/reuse contracts; lifecycle = init/teardown/creation order/ownership; mix = >=2 of these, each independently needed (positives) or each on the harness path (negatives), with the same visibility and introduced value.
